acquisition.source: Exact same 381 original frozen inputs and EXP-084 capture snapshot, plus the complete EXP-088 card-reference checkpoint inventory.

adoption: No production adoption from this recovery. EXP-078 remains terminal inconclusive; separate untouched confirmation and full product delivery remain required.

candidate.contract: Exact EXP-076 canonical complete-pool dual Score populations and equal-weight Fraction RRF k60. Same query/purpose instructions, criteria, model, projection and tie rule; only fresh caller task/pool data differ.
candidate.phase_includes: fresh construction/serialization, exchange, parsing/fusion, final receipt fsync

capture.health: One read-only health request after new EXP-089 admission; parse status and runtime identity, require the pinned free model/revision, and retain only nonsecret identity fields. Failure is terminal.
capture.raw_content_publication: private evidence storage; public sanitized hashes/aggregates only
capture.source_snapshot: Reuse the complete pinned EXP-084 capture subtree and its 442-source inventory; do not dispatch source HTTP requests or rewrite any captured bytes. Use the same bounded source contexts and source availability states.

card_reference_ids.catalog: For each frozen card, partition title/url/snippet independently in field order into consecutive non-overlapping Python-Unicode-code-point windows. Greedily extend each window while its UTF-8 encoding stays at or below 256 bytes; empty fields have no windows. Preserve every field character exactly once.
card_reference_ids.closure: Pin the exact EXP-088 card-reference adapter, short-label codec, prompt, preparation frontend, and tests in the EXP-089 source closure before admission; re-run their deterministic validation against all sixteen carried assignments.
card_reference_ids.failure: Unknown, cross-card, malformed, or unhydratable IDs, duplicate catalog IDs, duplicate facets/cards, or incomplete card/facet coverage remain invalid and terminal. Repeated IDs that each resolve within the same card are accepted and expanded once per occurrence in emitted order; no model response is repaired or deduplicated.
card_reference_ids.granularity: A selected ID hydrates to its complete deterministic window, not a model-selected subspan. Windows may include adjacent text; that bounded citation granularity is disclosed and is not a new content judgment.
card_reference_ids.hydration: Only known IDs assigned to the exact card and field are accepted. Hydration deterministically expands each ID to the legacy `{field, quote}` form and runs the unchanged exact-substring/byte-limit validator. No model-authored quote, field, offsets, or cross-card references.
card_reference_ids.id_derivation: IDs use the frozen exp077-card-reference-id/1 domain and bind task ID, card SHA-256, field name, window index and window-text SHA-256. Exact catalog entries also bind Unicode start/end and UTF-8 text hash.
card_reference_ids.input_presentation: The model receives the unchanged full original card fields plus the deterministic per-card window catalog. Both assessors receive the identical presentation and same finite IDs. This duplication/windowing is a prospective presentation change; do not compare grades directly to EXP-084.
card_reference_ids.output_shape: Keep the frozen EXP-077 arrays and item schema exactly: no uniqueItems constraint for anchors or facet_anchors. Repeated known same-card evidence_id values are valid array entries and hydrate to repeated legacy {field, quote} objects in exactly the same order. All other frozen checks remain unchanged.
card_reference_ids.purpose: Mechanical transport for the unchanged exact same-card anchor requirement.
card_reference_ids.semantic_scope: Does not alter lead/visible axes, facet definitions, scoring anchors, rubric, or thresholds. Window presentation is a prospective measurement change; preserve full original fields and present the same catalog to A and B.

card_reference_labels.identity: Card labels are assigned from the complete per-task card catalogs with stable per-card ordinals; source labels are assigned from the complete per-task source-ID universe and use a content-derived 16-hex passage suffix so labels do not change across chunk/arm subsets. The same source/passage has one label in source and answer-assessor roles.
card_reference_labels.invalid: Unknown, malformed, cross-task, cross-card, or cross-source aliases and binding/hash mismatches remain invalid and terminal. No model-response repair, deduplication, evidence change, rubric change, or grade change.
card_reference_labels.output_carrier: No changes to model-facing short-label grammar or response semantics. EXP-089 changes only how final text is captured.
card_reference_labels.presentation: Keep every card field, source passage, catalog row, context, task, and non-reference response value in its original order and exact content. Replace only reference identifiers at the registered model-facing fields.
card_reference_labels.purpose: Replace long evidence identifiers with deterministic short labels only in model-facing evidence-reference fields. Decode each label back to its exact original identifier before unchanged EXP-077 validation.
card_reference_labels.stability: Task-scoped mappings derive from the complete canonical catalog/universe and are independent of rank, arm, request order, and response order. Source aliases use the full per-task frozen source-ID universe shared by both arms.
card_reference_labels.transport: Preserve exact raw vendor response bytes in separate private response receipts. Store decoded portable response bytes separately. Both forms have independent hashes and response-size checks. Preserve field content, claim/rationale text, list order, multiplicity, and all non-reference fields exactly.

confirmation_scope.future_requirement: A separate confirmation must use entirely new tasks and pools with fresh independent references; no carried EXP-088 card references or EXP-089 development outputs qualify as confirmation.

consumer.alias_limitations: record configured and returned model identity; do not assert immutable checkpoint equivalence
consumer.source_availability_and_ordering: apply same dedup/refusal/video/availability policy to each fixed top-ten order; preserve failed openings separately

duplicate_reference_policy.allowed: Repeated known IDs bound to the same card and field, in anchors or a facet_anchors list; expand every occurrence in original order.
duplicate_reference_policy.change: Mechanical validator alignment only: remove the EXP-086-only duplicate-reference-ID rejection.

final_json_carrier.answer_output_manifest_coverage: Exactly 16 complete d1-d8 × w0/candidate answer receipts with their exact response and durable receipt hashes and byte counts.
final_json_carrier.answer_slot_bindings: Predeclare 32 answer-assessor identities only. After the 16 answer outputs are complete and frozen in a complete answer-output manifest, bind exact answer-assessment input hashes, schema/prompt hashes, and label-binding hashes for all 32 slots once before the first answer-assessor dispatch; record the manifest digest.
final_json_carrier.purpose: Replace only final-response capture. The receiver obtains the exact current agent final text and persists its UTF-8 bytes without parsing, repair, normalization, fence removal, or reconstruction; the existing frozen parser and validators consume the retained bytes afterward.
final_json_carrier.receipt: Receipt binds slot, role, exact raw final-text SHA-256 and byte count, frozen input and label-binding hashes; output storage uses exclusive create plus file and parent-directory fsync.
final_json_carrier.slot_plan: Source slots match the frozen EXP-077 assignment-plan logical_submission values for the 48 active source chunks only; the sixteen no-call trailing source slots do not receive invented inputs. Answer-assessor identities are predeclared; their exact inputs are bound once after answer outputs and packets are frozen, before the first answer-assessor call.
final_json_carrier.source_slot_bindings: All 48 exact source-assessment packet hashes freeze before any source-assessor dispatch.

covers: local validation of carried card references
fresh_stage_scope.reuse_does_not_reset_or_extend_clock: Only the newly admitted EXP-089 stage receives a clock; EXP-084 acquisition/capture and EXP-088 card-reference time receive zero credit.
fresh_stage_scope.starts_before: the single candidate health request and first fresh source assessment

grading_order: verify all 513 pinned frozen inputs, including the EXP-088 completed card checkpoint; exclude failed source grader output
perform source and CLI preflight; create and consume the new EXP-089 admission and clock
perform at most one read-only candidate health check; stop on failure
regenerate and validate all sixteen carried card assignments and raw-to-decoded-to-legacy verification; expose only structural hashes/counts
prepare/freeze 48 source slot input bindings before source-assessor calls
collect all 48 source assessments with exact-final-text carrier and unchanged validators
freeze exact 32 answer-assessment inputs before the first answer-assessor call; collect all 32 with exact-final-text carrier
verify receipts and calculate the unchanged frozen endpoints

input_provenance.source: Exact EXP-088 frozen input bundle inventory; no failed source submission, source grader output, or grade analysis is carried forward.

jev_invocation.call_slots: neutral capacity pair plus 13 base and 8 repeat/rotate operation pairs

models.answer_calls_basis: 16 task/arm answers plus 2 declared neutral readiness checks
models.answer_provider_surface: Existing process-configured OpenAI-compatible provider; secrets and endpoint values stay in memory and out of public artifacts.
models.card_and_source_and_answer_assessors: Carried card references are the sixteen fully validated EXP-088 A/B assignments; no card calls occur. Fresh source and answer assessors are independent GPT-6 Luna packets, not human gold. EXP-084 grader outputs are never reused.
models.cumulative_development_luna_call_account: The 17 EXP-088 historical submissions remain charged; 80 new source/answer assessment calls yield cumulative 97 of 112. No refund or reclassification.
models.reported_usage: retain where exposed; in-app grader billing/tokens may be unobservable, never invent them

phase_plan.assessment-preparation: Local deterministic source/answer packet preparation under the new stage phase guard.
phase_plan.carried-card-validation: Local deterministic regeneration and byte/hash/coverage validation of the frozen EXP-088 card checkpoint. It is not a grader/model phase and cannot issue a card-reference permit.
phase_plan.source-reference: Fresh independent source judgments over the same bounded contexts; no source HTTP requests.

predecessor.failure: The card checkpoint completed, then the first source-assessment final-output writing step failed. No source/answer assessments, selector/Jev, or quality analysis were completed.
predecessor.relation: Prospective continuation with a new clock and authority; no time, lease, or call credit from EXP-088.
predecessor.reuse: Reuse only the complete sixteen validated card-reference assignments and their raw/decoded/verified artifacts as immutable development references. The first failed source submission and its script are excluded; all 48 source and 32 answer assessments are fresh.

purpose: Prospective development continuation after EXP-088 stopped before source grading. Carry forward the complete, hash-bound sixteen-assignment A/B card-reference checkpoint without reading or analyzing its grade values; collect all source and answer assessments fresh. The only intervention is the response carrier: persist the exact current agent final-message UTF-8 bytes, then run unchanged validation. Do not repair, parse-and-reserialize, strip fences, or infer missing output.

recovery_runtime.health: One current read-only health request after the new EXP-089 admission, bound to the same frozen free-model identity; no retries.
recovery_runtime.health_request: One post-admission health request; accept only HTTP 200, status ok, runtime.model free, and runtime.revision equal to the pinned EXP-084 health identity. No retry or source/model activity follows failure.
recovery_runtime.private_binding: Root-owned private salted configuration receipt binds the exact per-process runtime config. Never place URL, key, user profile, or raw config values in public protocol, source, logs, or receipts.
recovery_runtime.purpose: No runtime or candidate change. Carry only the exact immutable card checkpoint; collect source and answer judgments fresh, using exact final-text byte capture and the unchanged validators.

stop: Any source/input/config integrity failure, health failure, unregistered request, budget/deadline breach, missing required endpoint, incomplete assessment, invalid raw final text, or unchanged-validator failure stops the stage with retained partial evidence; no retries, searches, rescue, tuning, replacement, imputation, repair, or automatic confirmation.

task_use.assessor_disagreements: separate endpoints, never average into a pass
task_use.completion: all declared critical checks supported, applicable and correctly applied to delivered evidence; model self-certification is insufficient
task_use.source_unavailability: recorded in denominators; not-acquired is an observed state, not automatically a structural packet error
task_use.uncertainty_report: Paired task bootstrap of completion-count difference, 10000 draws, seed7701; descriptive only, no additional significance gate.

wire_types.authority_boundary: Preserve exp078-stage-clock/1 and EXP-078 payload schemas only as portable data types for frozen selector/answer helpers. Mint a new EXP-089 stage ID and bind it to EXP-089 registration, qualification, manifest, inputs, and lease. Never accept any earlier stage clock, capability, permit, or lease as EXP-089 authority.
wire_types.card_reference_ids: The EXP-088 card-reference outputs are immutable, byte- and hash-bound development inputs. Do not re-dispatch or regrade cards in EXP-089.
wire_types.portable_reuse: EXP-078 effective acquisition, card, selector, and receipt structures are immutable input/wire types only.
